Overview of GACL Recruitment 2026

Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited (GACL) has announced recruitment notifications for various positions including Assistant Engineer, Assistant Officer, and Trainee Operation Assistant. Eligible candidates can submit their applications through the online portal.

Vacancy Details and Job Roles

  • Issuing Authority: Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited (GACL)
  • Notification ID: Not specified
  • Job Locations: Dahej and Baroda, Gujarat (subject to change as per company requirements)
  • Posts Advertised: Assistant Engineer (Process), Assistant Officer (Fire), Assistant Engineer (Electrical), and Trainee Operation Assistant.

Eligibility Criteria and Qualifications

  • Assistant Engineer (Process): Full-time B.E./B.Tech in Chemical Engineering with a minimum of 2 years of experience in chemical plant operations.
  • Assistant Officer (Fire): B.Sc./B.E. in Fire and Safety with 2 years of experience in chemical, petrochemical, or refinery industries.
  • Assistant Engineer (Electrical): Full-time B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering with at least 1 year of experience in operation and electrical system maintenance.
  • Trained Operation Assistant: Diploma in Chemical Engineering or B.Sc. in Chemistry passed in 2025 or 2026 with at least 60% marks. This position is on a 5-year contract basis with potential regularization.

Important Dates and Application Process

  • Application Start Date: October 28, 2026
  • Application Deadline: November 8, 2026
  • Age Cut-off Date: Not specified
  • Application Fee: Not specified
  • Selection Stages: Online application screening; meeting educational criteria does not guarantee an interview call.
  • Result, Admit Card, and Answer Key Status: Not specified

How to Apply

  1. Visit the official GACL portal at `gaclportal.gacl.co.in`.
  2. Navigate to the recruitment section and locate the post-specific apply link.
  3. Complete the registration using basic details such as email ID, date of birth, and mobile number.
  4. Log in with the generated credentials to fill out personal, educational, and experience details, and upload the required CV before submitting.

Applicants should verify all announcements, notices, and links directly on the official GACL recruitment website.
